title: Jules as AIGestion's Autonomous PR Generator
description: Integrate Google Jules API to accept feature descriptions from the AIGestion chat interface and produce real, reviewable GitHub PRs. When a user approves a proposal card in the chat UI, DanielaOS sends the task to Jules, which clones the repo, implements the change across multiple files, runs tests, and opens a PR. This replaces the current simulated code generation with actual autonomous coding.
key_features: Jules API integration in api_gateway.py
Chat proposal card → Jules task creation pipeline
GitHub PR webhook back to AIGestion for status tracking
PR review notification in chat interface
Free tier: 15 tasks/day covers daily development needs
impact: Transforms AIGestion from a chat interface that talks about code into a platform that writes and ships real code. 15 free autonomous PRs/day is enough for continuous feature development.

title: Android Studio CLI Bridge for App Build/Test
description: Use Jules' Android Studio CLI integration to automate the full Android app lifecycle: build, run emulator tests, and deploy the AIGestion Android app to Play Console test tracks. When Jules opens a PR affecting the Android app, it can automatically run instrumented tests in an emulator before the PR is reviewable.
key_features: Android Studio CLI bridge in android_control.py
Automated emulator test runs on PR creation
Play Console test track deployment from chat approval
Build status displayed in AIGestion HUD
impact: Closes the loop from feature request to shipped Android app with zero manual build steps.

title: Firebase AI Logic as Agent-Native Backend
description: Migrate AIGestion's backend from local Flask scripts to Firebase AI Logic, which provides agent-native infrastructure: real-time data sync, authentication, cloud functions, and Firestore. Jules tasks can deploy Firebase functions directly. DanielaOS agents use Firestore as their shared state store instead of local JSON files.
key_features: Firebase Firestore as shared agent state store
Firebase Cloud Functions for agent API endpoints
Firebase Auth replacing auth_system.py
Real-time sync between web UI and agent state
Jules can deploy Firebase functions as part of PRs
replaces: Local JSON files for state (battery_state.json, calendar_events.json, etc.)
impact: Eliminates the local-file-state problem. Agents, web UI, and mobile all see the same real-time state. Jules can modify backend infrastructure in PRs.

title: Jules V2 'Jitro' KPI-Driven Development
description: When Jules V2 'Jitro' launches with KPI-driven development, integrate it so DanielaOS can define success metrics (e.g., 'reduce API response time below 200ms', 'increase test coverage to 90%') and Jules autonomously iterates until KPIs are met. DanielaOS monitors KPI dashboards and dispatches Jules tasks when metrics drift.
key_features: KPI definition interface in AIGestion dashboard
DanielaOS monitoring loop checking KPI thresholds
Automatic Jules task dispatch on KPI regression
KPI achievement notification in chat UI
impact: Autonomous continuous improvement. DanielaOS doesn't just detect problems — it autonomously fixes them through Jules until measurable KPIs are achieved.

title: Replace Swarm Dispatcher with Antigravity Multi-Agent Orchestration
description: Replace auto_swarm_dispatcher.py (which makes sequential local API calls) with Antigravity's multi-agent desktop application. DanielaOS's 9 agents run as parallel Antigravity subagents with dynamic task allocation. The Antigravity desktop app provides a visual orchestration view showing all agents working simultaneously.
key_features: Antigravity desktop app as DanielaOS orchestration layer
9 agents as Antigravity subagent templates
Dynamic subagent spawning for parallel workflows
Visual agent orchestration dashboard
Real parallel execution (not simulated)
impact: Eliminates the #1 gap identified in agent_epic_ideas.py: 'Swarm intelligence uses SIMULATED execution'. Real parallel agent execution with visual oversight.

title: Antigravity SDK for Cloud-Hosted DanielaOS Agents
description: Use the Antigravity SDK to programmatically host DanielaOS agents on Google Cloud infrastructure instead of local Python processes. Agents become cloud services with autoscaling, persistent state, and 24/7 availability. The SDK enables custom agent hosting on the project's own infrastructure.
key_features: DanielaOS agents as Antigravity SDK hosted services
Google Cloud autoscaling for agent workloads
24/7 agent availability (no local machine required)
Custom agent hosting infrastructure
Agent state persistence in Cloud Storage
impact: DanielaOS becomes a true cloud operating system. Agents run 24/7 without requiring Alejandro's machine to be on. Enterprise-grade infrastructure.

title: Scheduled Agent Tasks via Antigravity
description: Replace daniela_proactive_engine_v2.py's scheduling with Antigravity's native scheduled tasks. Define cron-like schedules for each of the 9 agents (e.g., GUARDIAN runs every 15 min, ANALYST runs every hour, CODER runs on PR events). Antigravity handles scheduling, retries, and execution.
key_features: Antigravity scheduled task definitions per agent
Native retry and failure notification
Schedule visualization in AIGestion dashboard
Event-triggered tasks (GitHub webhook, chat message, KPI threshold)
impact: Reliable, native scheduling without custom cron implementations. Agents run on schedule even when no one is watching the dashboard.

title: Migrate from Gemini CLI to Antigravity CLI
description: Migrate all Gemini CLI usage in the AIGestion codebase to the Antigravity CLI (which Google is positioning as Gemini CLI's successor). This ensures compatibility with the latest agent infrastructure and unlocks Antigravity-specific features like multi-agent orchestration from the command line.
key_features: Audit all Gemini CLI references in codebase
Replace with Antigravity CLI equivalents
Update deployment scripts and CI/CD
Migration guide for team reference
replaces: All Gemini CLI usage in scripts and automation
impact: Future-proofs the codebase. Antigravity CLI is the supported path going forward.

title: Managed Agents API for Cloud-Hosted DanielaOS Agents
description: Use AI Studio's Managed Agents via Interactions API to create cloud-hosted versions of DanielaOS's 9 agents. A single API call spins up a reasoning agent with tool use and code execution in an isolated Linux environment. State persists across calls. Each agent gets its own persistent environment with files intact between interactions.
key_features: 9 Managed Agent instances (one per DanielaOS agent role)
Persistent Linux environments per agent
Tool use: web search, code execution, file I/O
Custom agent templates via markdown (matches skills/ pattern)
Interactions API integration in api_gateway.py
replaces: Local agent execution in agents.py (limited by local compute)
impact: Solves state management (persistent envs), compute limitations (cloud execution), and infrastructure complexity. Agents become real cloud services with one API call.

title: Workspace Integration: Real Gmail/Docs/Calendar Automation
description: Connect DanielaOS agents to real Google Workspace APIs through AI Studio's native integration. Instead of simulated 'send email' or 'create calendar event' actions, agents call Gmail, Docs, and Calendar APIs directly. The 5 fictional agent characters (Correo, Calendario, Documentos, Redes, Vigia) become real Workspace-connected agents.
key_features: Correo agent → Gmail API (read, draft, send)
Calendario agent → Calendar API (create, update, query events)
Documentos agent → Docs API (create, edit, export documents)
Real OAuth flow for Workspace access
Agent action audit log in AIGestion dashboard
impact: The 5 fictional agent characters become real, useful automation agents. No more simulated actions — every agent action produces a real Google Workspace result.

title: Android App Building from Prompt → Play Console
description: Use AI Studio's Native Android support to build and publish AIGestion's Android app from natural language descriptions. Users describe a feature in the chat UI, AI Studio generates an Android app, and publishes to the Play Console test track for immediate testing on real devices.
key_features: Feature description → Android app generation pipeline
Play Console test track auto-publishing
Feature flag integration for A/B testing
Device testing feedback loop in AIGestion dashboard
impact: Feature-to-app in minutes instead of weeks. The Android app evolves through natural language descriptions, not manual coding.

title: AI Studio Mobile App for Remote Agent Monitoring
description: Use the AI Studio mobile app (when released) to monitor and interact with DanielaOS agents remotely. Push notifications for agent task completion, KPI alerts, and approval requests. Approve proposal cards from mobile without opening the full web dashboard.
key_features: Push notifications for agent events
Mobile proposal card approval/rejection
Agent status monitoring on mobile
Quick chat with DanielaOS from mobile
impact: Alejandro can monitor and control DanielaOS from anywhere. Agent approval workflows become mobile-first.

title: Markdown-Defined Agent Templates for All 9 Agents
description: Define each of DanielaOS's 9 agents as markdown template files for AI Studio's Managed Agents. Each template specifies the agent's role, tools, system prompt, and skill set. This matches the existing skills/ pattern in the codebase and makes agents portable, version-controlled, and editable without code changes.
key_features: 9 markdown agent templates (one per role)
Role-specific tool definitions per agent
Skill inheritance from skills/ directory
Version-controlled agent definitions in Git
Hot-reload agent templates without restart
impact: Agents become configuration, not code. Non-technical users can adjust agent behavior by editing markdown. Agents are portable across infrastructure.

title: WebMCP: Expose AIGestion API as Structured Tools for Browser Agents
description: Implement WebMCP on the AIGestion web interface to expose JavaScript functions and HTML forms as structured tools that any browser-based agent (Chrome Gemini, Antigravity web agents, third-party agents) can call directly. Instead of screen-scraping, agents call AIGestion's API functions natively: create_task(), approve_proposal(), query_agent_status(), etc.
key_features: WebMCP manifest declaring AIGestion's callable functions
Structured tool definitions for all API endpoints
Chrome 149 origin trial participation
Agent authentication via WebMCP (scoped permissions)
Tool discovery for third-party agents
impact: AIGestion becomes a web-native agent platform. Any browser agent can interact with AIGestion's features programmatically. This is the bridge between the web UI and the agent ecosystem.

title: Built-in Prompt API: Zero-Cost On-Device AI for Landing Page
description: Use Chrome's built-in Prompt API (stable in Chrome 148) to power the landing page demo chat with on-device AI. No API key needed, no server calls, no cost. The model runs in the browser. Falls back to Gemini API for unsupported browsers. Also use Gemma 197M for task-specific APIs: summarizer for content previews, translator for multilingual support, language detector for auto-localization.
key_features: On-device Prompt API for landing page demo chat
Zero API cost for demo interactions
Graceful fallback to Gemini API for non-Chrome browsers
Gemma 197M summarizer for content card previews
Gemma translator for instant multilingual UI
Multimodal input (text + image) for rich demo
Structured JSON output for proposal cards
replaces: Gemini API calls for demo chat on landing page
impact: Eliminates API costs for all landing page demo interactions. The demo chat works offline, instantly, with no rate limits. Huge for viral sharing — visitors can try AIGestion without any backend cost.

title: Chrome DevTools for Agents: Real-Time Frontend Debugging
description: Enable Chrome DevTools for Agents protocol so DanielaOS's CODER agent can access real-time console logs, network requests, and accessibility tree of the AIGestion web interface. When a user reports a bug, DanielaOS inspects the running frontend directly through DevTools — no manual screenshot reproduction needed.
key_features: DevTools for Agents protocol integration
CODER agent accesses console/network/a11y tree
Automated bug reproduction from DevTools data
Performance profiling via Lighthouse data for agents
AI-assisted debugging widgets in DevTools
dependencies: Chrome with DevTools for Agents enabled
replaces: Manual bug reproduction and screenshot-based debugging
impact: DanielaOS can debug the frontend it builds. The CODER agent sees real console errors, network failures, and accessibility issues — then dispatches Jules to fix them.

title: HTML-in-Canvas: DOM Overlays on Daniela's 3D Avatar
description: Use Chrome's HTML-in-Canvas API to render DOM elements directly inside the WebGL/WebGPU canvas where Daniela's Three.js particle avatar lives. Chat bubbles, proposal cards, status indicators, and HUD elements float in 3D space around the avatar instead of being separate DOM overlays. Creates a unified immersive interface.
key_features: Chat bubbles rendered inside 3D canvas near avatar
Proposal cards as 3D-positioned DOM elements
Agent status indicators as 3D HUD elements
Smooth transitions between 2D and 3D UI elements
Element-scoped View Transitions for smooth state changes
impact: AIGestion's interface becomes a true mixed-reality experience. DOM elements and 3D objects coexist seamlessly. Visually stunning and functionally integrated.

title: Auto Browse: DanielaOS Browser Automation 24/7
description: Integrate Chrome's Auto Browse feature to give DanielaOS real browser control for 24/7 task automation. Agents can navigate websites, fill forms, extract data, and perform multi-step web workflows autonomously. Gemini Spark integration (coming soon) enables complex reasoning during browsing. Replaces simulated web actions with real browser automation.
key_features: Auto Browse integration in DanielaOS OPERATOR agent
Multi-step web workflow automation (login, navigate, extract, report)
Gemini Spark integration for complex browsing reasoning
Screenshot + DOM state capture for audit logs
WebMCP-aware browsing (call structured tools when available)
Session persistence for authenticated browsing
replaces: Simulated web actions in OPERATOR agent
impact: DanielaOS becomes a real web automation agent. It doesn't just talk about browsing the web — it actually browses, extracts, and acts on web content 24/7.

title: Chrome Skills: Reusable AI Workflows for Content Creation
description: Create Chrome Skills (saved, reusable multi-tab AI prompt workflows) for AIGestion's content creation pipeline. Pre-built workflows for: blog post generation (research → draft → optimize → publish), social media campaign (trend analysis → content → schedule → post), competitor monitoring (monitor → analyze → report), and code documentation (scan → document → PR).
key_features: Content creation Chrome Skills (blog, social, docs, monitoring)
Multi-tab AI workflow templates
One-click workflow execution from AIGestion dashboard
Workflow sharing and community templates
Integration with viral_content_factory.py pipeline
impact: Content creation becomes one-click. DanielaOS loads the right Chrome Skill, opens the right tabs, and runs the AI workflow automatically.

title: Chrome Gemini on Android: Mobile Agent Actions
description: Integrate Chrome Gemini on Android to extend DanielaOS agent actions to mobile browsing. Agents can perform web tasks on Alejandro's Android device: research while browsing, extract calendar events from web pages, save content to Keep, and send emails via Gmail — all from the mobile Chrome browser with DanielaOS direction.
key_features: Chrome Gemini Android integration
Mobile web task automation (Calendar, Keep, Gmail)
Personal Intelligence features (context-aware suggestions)
Mobile browsing assistant powered by DanielaOS
Voice input across mobile web for hands-free agent control
impact: DanielaOS follows Alejandro to mobile. Agent actions work on the phone's browser, not just the desktop. True cross-device agent presence.

title: Gemini 3.5 Pro 2M Context: Whole-Codebase Analysis
description: Use Gemini 3.5 Pro's 2M-token context window to analyze the entire AIGestion codebase in a single prompt. DanielaOS's ANALYST agent can reason about the full project architecture, cross-file dependencies, and system-wide patterns without chunking or RAG. Architecture reviews, security audits, and refactoring recommendations become single-call operations.
key_features: Full codebase context injection (2M tokens = ~500K lines of code)
Architecture analysis in a single API call
Cross-file dependency mapping
Security audit with complete code visibility
Refactoring recommendations with project-wide context
Arquitecto.py upgraded to use full-context analysis
replaces: RAG-based code search in ANALYST agent (limited context)
impact: DanielaOS sees the entire project at once. No more blind spots from context truncation. Architecture decisions are made with full information, not fragments.

title: Gemini 3.5 Flash as Default for Real-Time Agent Responses
description: Switch all DanielaOS agents from current model to Gemini 3.5 Flash as the default model for real-time responses. Flash is 4x faster than frontier models and outperforms Gemini 3.1 Pro on most benchmarks. Reserve Gemini 3.5 Pro for tasks requiring deep reasoning or the 2M context window.
key_features: Flash as default model for all 9 agents
Automatic Pro upgrade for tasks >100K tokens or deep reasoning
Model selection logic in api_gateway.py
Cost optimization: Flash at $1.50/M input vs Pro pricing
4x faster chat responses for AIGestion users
replaces: Current model configuration in all agent modules
impact: 4x faster agent responses at lower cost. Users perceive instant interactions. Pro reserved for where it matters — architecture, deep analysis, full-context reasoning.

title: Structured JSON Output for Native Proposal Cards
description: Use Gemini 3.5's native structured JSON output to generate proposal cards directly from the model — no prompt engineering or parsing hacks. The model returns a JSON object with title, description, impact, effort, and action items that maps directly to the proposal card UI component. Eliminates fragile regex parsing of model output.
key_features: Native JSON schema for proposal cards
Schema: {title, description, impact, effort, actions[], files[]}
No regex/parsing of model output
Type-safe proposal card generation
Consistent card format across all agents
replaces: Prompt engineering + regex parsing for proposal card extraction
impact: Proposal cards are always well-formed. No more broken UI from malformed model output. Every agent produces consistent, structured proposals.

title: Free Tier Deep Research for Proactive Intelligence
description: Exploit Gemini's free tier (5 Deep Research reports/month) to fuel DanielaOS's proactive engine. Schedule 5 monthly deep research tasks on: industry trends, competitor analysis, technology radar, user feedback synthesis, and codebase improvement opportunities. Results feed into the content calendar and agent task queue.
key_features: 5 monthly Deep Research tasks scheduled automatically
Research topics: trends, competitors, tech radar, feedback, codebase
Results parsed into actionable agent tasks
Content calendar auto-population from research findings
Integration with daniela_proactive_engine_v2.py
impact: Free, high-quality research fueling proactive agent actions. DanielaOS knows what's happening in the industry and acts on it — without any API cost.

title: Gemini Live Voice Mode for DanielaOS Voice Interactions
description: Integrate Gemini Live's real-time voice mode into AIGestion for natural voice conversations with DanielaOS. Users speak naturally, DanielaOS responds with voice. Enables hands-free agent control, mobile voice interaction, and accessibility. Combined with Chrome's voice input across the web for a fully voice-native experience.
key_features: Real-time voice conversation with DanielaOS
Voice-activated agent task dispatch
Voice proposal card reading (text-to-speech for accessibility)
Mobile voice control via Chrome voice input
Voice command shortcuts ('Hey Daniela, check the servers')
replaces: Text-only chat interface as the sole interaction method
impact: AIGestion becomes a voice-first assistant on mobile and desktop. Hands-free agent control while coding, driving, or walking. Accessibility win.
